toegepas.voor: Die twee stede lê naby mekaar en 'n brief
toegepas.na: Die twee stede lê naby mekaar, en 'n brief
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb (comma only, not the rejected 'maar').
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('Die twee stede le' and ''n brief het').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required AWS 2017 comma, adds no word and keeps 'en' rather than the previously rejected 'maar'.

laat_vaar.voor: kon dus net boodskappe stuur waar
laat_vaar.na: kon dus boodskappe net stuur waar
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'net' must stand before the restricted part (where), not before 'boodskappe', which reads as 'only messages'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: In Afrikaans 'net' before the object naturally scopes over the whole predicate, so the original already reads as 'only where a wire was strung'; the move is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die twee stede lê naby mekaar en 'n brief
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die twee stede lê naby mekaar, maar 'n brief
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The two clauses stand in contrast (close together, yet hours), so 'maar' with its comma states the link the sentence already implies.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Swapping 'en' for 'maar' adds a contrast the original does not assert (the contrast is with the telegraph's minutes in the next sentence), and the original reads fine.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: praat mense vandag nog daarvan om geld te 'wire'
laat_vaar_vorige.na: sê mense vandag nog dat hulle geld 'wire'
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'praat daarvan om geld te wire' is wooden; 'sê dat hulle geld wire' is the natural way to report the English usage, with the same meaning and length.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original 'praat daarvan om geld te wire' is natural Afrikaans for naming an expression, and the proposal is a lateral move that also shifts the sense from using the term to people reporting their own action.
